core_principles.description: Understanding cycle position matters more than stock selection. Fight the cycle and you lose.
Best returns come from unloved, unfashionable assets. Popularity is the enemy of returns.

core_principles.description: Only invest where you genuinely understand the asset. Conviction without knowledge is speculation.
Maintain financial strength through cycles. Being cashed up during crises creates asymmetric opportunity.
Think in years, not months. The market eventually recognizes value, but timing is uncertain.
Acknowledge forecasting errors openly. Saying I was wrong is a competitive advantage.
Decades of underinvestment in natural resources create structural supply constraints supporting multi-year commodity strength.

risk_philosophy: Risk is not to be avoided but understood and priced. Being compensated appropriately for risk taken is the goal.
